title: A Chat with Dexter Jettster
front_description: Investigating the mysterious toxic dart, Obi-Wan visits a Coruscant diner and links up with his old, multi-armed alien pal, Dexter Jettster. "This baby belongs to them cloners," offers Dex as he stares at the tiny object. "What you got here is a Kamino Saberdart." Dexter explains that the planet Kamino is beyond the Outer Rim, "about twelve parsecs outside the Rishi Maze." Obi-Wan thanks his immense friend and heads to the Jedi Archives.
back_description: Dermot Power's concept design of Dexter Jettster, Obi-Wan multi-armed contact.
